# M3-14b: Categorize job in serve

- Milestone: M3
- Branch / worktree: `t/M3-14b`, `../YNAB_AutoCategorizer.wt/M3-14b`
- Depends on: M3-14a, M3-11, M3-7, M3-9
- Touches (exclusive while running): cmd/, config/
- Plan refs: §3.2, §5a daily probe, §7 M3, N2
- YNAB access: none
- Deploy: no (smoke: none; ships in M3-17)

## Goal
After each successful sync, `serve` runs the pipeline in the configured mode. The mode defaults to off and only `deploy/compose.yaml` sets it.

## Scope
- Config: `CLASSIFY_MODE` (`off`/`dry_run`/`auto`, default `off`; anything else is a startup error), `JEV_API_KEY`, `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`, `CLAUDE_BIN`, `CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR`, `CLASSIFY_BACKLOG_DAYS`, `CLASSIFY_MAX_OPEN_QUESTIONS`, `CLASSIFY_AUTO_SINCE` (optional date). Pass `calibrate.Current()` into the pipeline as `classify.Calibration`.
- Run on the scheduler goroutine after a successful sync, skipping a sync that was skipped or failed. Bound it with a ctx (at most 5 minutes) so sync ticks keep flowing.
- Construct the writer with the effective mode; `dry_run` never gets a live one. Wire Slack's `Applier` to it, and call `CloseStale` after sync.
- Log one line per run: mode, effective mode, counts, warnings. No ids.
- Surface a run failure or an `auto` downgrade in the Slack status message (`status/` already takes a text; add only what the existing interface allows, else leave it to M3-15).
- Daily `llm.Probe`; failure is a critical alert.

## Out of scope
- Setting the mode in compose (M3-17, M3-golive). A CLI to change the mode: there must be none.

## Acceptance (each must be demonstrably checked)
- [ ] Config tests: default off; a bad value fails startup and names the variable.
- [ ] Test: mode off constructs no pipeline and makes no model calls.
- [ ] Test: a failed or budget-skipped sync doesn't run the pipeline.
- [ ] Test: `dry_run` wiring returns `ErrDryRun` from a Slack answer path (no HTTP).
- [ ] Test: a job past its bound is cancelled and the next sync still runs.
- [ ] Test: a probe failure sends one critical alert.
- [ ] go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./... green
